llm_response.reason: Several scam characteristics are present: (1) The website features aggressively low prices and repeated sales wording ('Superaanbiedingen'), (2) the use of 'NUBIKK' branding despite no evidence it is an authorized retailer, (3) missing verifiable company/contact information with only a generic 'contact' and ambiguous 'privacybeleid', (4) the domain and company info are suspicious/not established, (5) common e-commerce legitimacy signals are mimicked (SSL, '100% Veilig winkelen'), but these can be easily faked, (6) no legitimate reviews or trust factors appear for this shop on trusted channels, (7) external search did not find this shop as an official NUBIKK partner. These combine to match multiple scam characteristics outlined, particularly those concerning mimicked branding, non-existent company info, and psychological targeting through sale offers.
